✅ INCREDIBLE. A PERSON.

Using AI is fine. Use it to think, research, or improve your writing. But for the love of God:

READ THE THING.
THINK ABOUT THE THING.
SAY WHAT YOU MEAN.

Then send it. You can even add an opinion. Scientists say this is possible.

Instead of…

“Certainly! I would be delighted to accommodate a meeting at your proposed time.”

Just say:

yep, 3 works

“This proposal presents a compelling opportunity with several key considerations.”

Just say:

i like the idea but that deadline is optimistic. can we do next week?

PR reviewer: “If I remove the last item from my cart, won’t this still add $5 shipping? Shouldn’t the total be $0?”

The reply: “It lands; the gap is found. You’ve identified a meaningful boundary condition in the relationship between cart state and shipping eligibility. The current implementation optimizes for the populated-cart happy path, but the transition to an empty cart introduces a subtle mismatch between the user’s mental model and the computed total. This is less a question of the five dollars in isolation and more an opportunity to make the underlying invariant explicit: shipping should reflect the presence of something to ship. A focused guard at the appropriate boundary would bring those concerns into alignment, with a targeted regression test to preserve the intended behavior going forward. The shape of the fix is small; the clarity it buys is substantial. Great catch.”

Cool. Can we remove the five dollars and most of that paragraph?

Just say:

yep, that’s a bug. i’ll skip shipping when the cart is empty and add a test.

It’s okay to use imperfect English. Typos, short replies, and disagreement are fine. “I don’t know” is fine. I’m your coworker, not an English examiner.

Signs you may be doing this

  • Yesterday: “lol yeah.” Today: “Let’s unpack the broader implications.”
  • You send 700 words in response to “are you free at 3?”
  • Someone asks what you meant and now you have to go ask AI.

Use AI. AI is useful. I use Claude. Probably too much.

But when I message you, please let there be at least one human involved in the conversation.

PLEASE DO NOT BECOME HUMAN MIDDLEWARE.
